SELECT
risk_level as groupKey
business_unit as groupKey
assessment_method as groupKey
assessor as groupKey
risk_level as groupKey
, COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN assessment_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) as completedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) as approvedCount, AVG(risk_score) as avgRiskScore, MIN(risk_score) as minRiskScore, MAX(risk_score) as maxRiskScore, SUM(risk_exposure) as totalRiskExposure, SUM(potential_loss) as totalPotentialLoss, AVG(assessment_cost) as avgAssessmentCost, SUM(assessment_cost) as totalAssessmentCost FROM gt_risk_assessment WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND assessment_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY groupKey ORDER BY totalCount DESC

SELECT assessor, COUNT(*) as totalAssessments, COUNT(CASE WHEN assessment_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) as completedAssessments, AVG(DATEDIFF(completion_date, assessment_date)) as avgDuration, MIN(DATEDIFF(completion_date, assessment_date)) as minDuration, MAX(DATEDIFF(completion_date, assessment_date)) as maxDuration, AVG(risk_score) as avgRiskScore, COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level IN ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL') THEN 1 END) as highRiskCount, AVG(assessment_cost) as avgCost, SUM(assessment_cost) as totalCost FROM gt_risk_assessment WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND assessment_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND completion_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY assessor ORDER BY completedAssessments DESC, avgDuration ASC

SELECT assessment_method, COUNT(*) as totalCount, AVG(risk_score) as avgRiskScore, STDDEV(risk_score) as riskScoreStdDev, COUNT(CASE WHEN mitigation_measures IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(mitigation_measures) > 50 THEN 1 END) as detailedMitigationCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN assessment_result IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(assessment_result) > 100 THEN 1 END) as detailedResultCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) as approvedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 END) as rejectedCount, AVG(DATEDIFF(approval_date, completion_date)) as avgApprovalDays FROM gt_risk_assessment WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND assessment_status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY assessment_method ORDER BY totalCount DESC

SELECT business_unit, risk_level, COUNT(*) as assessmentCount, AVG(assessment_cost) as avgCost, MIN(assessment_cost) as minCost, MAX(assessment_cost) as maxCost, SUM(assessment_cost) as totalCost, AVG(risk_score) as avgRiskScore, SUM(risk_exposure) as totalRiskExposure, SUM(potential_loss) as totalPotentialLoss, (SUM(assessment_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(risk_exposure), 0)) * 100 as costRiskRatio FROM gt_risk_assessment WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND assessment_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND assessment_cost IS NOT NULL GROUP BY business_unit, risk_level ORDER BY totalCost DESC

SELECT assessment_id, assessment_no, risk_level, assessment_status, assessment_date, completion_date, next_assessment_date, CASE WHEN assessment_status = 'PENDING' AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), assessment_date) > 30 THEN 'LONG_PENDING' WHEN assessment_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), assessment_date) > 15 THEN 'OVERDUE_PROGRESS' WHEN next_assessment_date IS NOT NULL AND next_assessment_date < CURDATE() THEN 'OVERDUE_NEXT' WHEN next_assessment_date IS NOT NULL AND next_assessment_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 'UPCOMING_NEXT' WHEN risk_level = 'CRITICAL' THEN 'CRITICAL_RISK' ELSE 'NORMAL' END as alertType FROM gt_risk_assessment WHERE org_id = #{orgId}
AND (
assessment_status = 'PENDING' AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), assessment_date) > 30
assessment_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), assessment_date) > 15
next_assessment_date IS NOT NULL AND next_assessment_date < CURDATE()
next_assessment_date IS NOT NULL AND next_assessment_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
risk_level = 'CRITICAL'
)
ORDER BY CASE alertType WHEN 'CRITICAL_RISK' THEN 1 WHEN 'OVERDUE_NEXT' THEN 2 WHEN 'OVERDUE_PROGRESS' THEN 3 WHEN 'LONG_PENDING' THEN 4 WHEN 'UPCOMING_NEXT' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, assessment_date DESC

SELECT ra.*, rt.risk_type_name, rt.risk_category, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE risk_type_id = ra.risk_type_id) as monitoringCount FROM gt_risk_assessment ra LEFT JOIN gt_risk_type_definition rt ON ra.risk_type_id = rt.risk_type_id WHERE ra.assessment_id = #{assessmentId}

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalAssessments, COUNT(CASE WHEN assessment_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) as completedAssessments, COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) as approvedAssessments, COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 END) as criticalAssessments, COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) as highAssessments, AVG(risk_score) as avgRiskScore, SUM(risk_exposure) as totalRiskExposure, SUM(potential_loss) as totalPotentialLoss, SUM(assessment_cost) as totalAssessmentCost, COUNT(CASE WHEN next_assessment_date IS NULL OR next_assessment_date < CURDATE() THEN 1 END) as overdueAssessments FROM gt_risk_assessment WHERE org_id = #{orgId}
SELECT operation_type, operation_content, operation_user, operation_time FROM gt_risk_assessment_history WHERE assessment_id = #{assessmentId} ORDER BY operation_time DESC

SELECT 'MONITORING' as dataType, COUNT(*) as count FROM gt_risk_monitoring WHERE risk_type_id = (SELECT risk_type_id FROM gt_risk_assessment WHERE assessment_id = #{assessmentId}) UNION ALL SELECT 'MITIGATION' as dataType, COUNT(*) as count FROM gt_risk_mitigation WHERE assessment_id = #{assessmentId}
